name: How long does it take to remove mold from around a window?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove mold from around a window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for mold removal around a window depends on the severity and spread of the mold. For surface-level mold, the cleaning and treatment process might take a few hours. However, if the mold has penetrated into the wall cavity or requires structural repairs, the project could extend over one to three days, including drying and potential reconstruction. A thorough assessment will determine the estimated timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold removal time depends on severity; surface mold takes hours, while extensive or structural issues can take one to three days, including repairs.
